as_told.title: Hermann Oberth claimed a relationship with nonhuman beings

plain: Hermann Oberth was a German rocket scientist and the mentor of Wernher von Braun, a famous rocket engineer. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says Oberth is on record saying that non-human intelligence helped them build rockets to go to space, and he points to a book called Secret Machines. In another episode Michels says there is even an audio recording of Oberth talking about UFOs, in which he says they were aided and had help. A guest, Jason Samosa, puts it more loosely: "the German guy, the Nazi guy," he says, claimed they had a relationship, without saying it was about rockets. So the story comes from the host repeating it in two episodes and from a guest who remembers it vaguely. If true, it would mean early space rockets owed something to beings from somewhere else.
